text: The Coastal and Estuarine Risk Mitigation Program (CERMP) is an initiative by the Australian Government aimed at reducing disaster risks for coastal and estuarine communities across Australia. Announced in 2022 and operational from March 2023, the program provides $50 million for projects focused on infrastructure, planning, and monitoring. It operates under the Emergency Response Fund framework and is part of the broader Disaster Ready Fund, with the National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) overseeing its administration. The program supports state-led administration and local delivery of projects, focusing on adaptation and resilience measures, planning, and monitoring activities.
